description: Java source code for an Android activity 'Bouncer' with a nested custom view 'MyView' that animates a bitmap shape using ValueAnimator.

classes.name: Bouncer
classes.description: Main activity class that sets the content view.

classes.name: MyView
classes.description: Custom view class that displays and animates a bitmap shape.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: setupShape
methods.description: Loads bitmap and sets up click listener to start animation.

methods.name: setShapeX
methods.description: Updates shape's X position and invalidates affected area.

methods.name: setShapeY
methods.description: Updates shape's Y position and invalidates affected area.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Centers shape horizontally when view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap at current position.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Creates and starts the ValueAnimator for animation.

methods.name: getValueAnimator
methods.description: Creates a ValueAnimator that updates shape's Y position.
